title: The Chaplains Museum

services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: Learn the essential role of military chaplains in the lives of service members and their families. Throughout American history, military chaplains have faced the challenges of war with a commitment to service. Each major exhibit in the museum supports this theme: Learn more about how the U.S. military chaplain serves and how the chaplain’s role has developed over time from the American founding to the present. See some of the objects chaplains have used to facilitate religious observance and conduct services no matter where they are. Featured items include chaplain kits, a World War II field organ, hymnbooks, and more. Learn about the many service organizations that have worked alongside
